supportingSources.label: Kineticist Shooting the Rapids machine guide and playfield

strategy.overview: Shooting the Rapids rewards complete A-B-C sets and progress through its yellow target route. Complete A-B-C once for 2x bonus, again for 3x, and a third time for 5x. The yellow drop targets and top lane advance the Special route. White advance-bonus shots build the end-of-ball bonus. Take the spinner while its larger displayed value is lit.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete A-B-C once for 2x bonus, twice for 3x, and three times for 5x. Hit the yellow drop targets and top lane to advance the Special route. Use the white advance-bonus shots to build bonus, and shoot the spinner while its higher value is lit.
strategy.summary: Finish A-B-C sets instead of leaving letters scattered; the first three completions raise Bonus X sharply. Use the yellow targets and top lane for Special progress, then take the spinner only when its lit value justifies the risk.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete A-B-C up to three times.

quickInfo.name: Build Special
quickInfo.summary: Hit the yellow drops and top lane.

quickInfo.name: Use the Spinner
quickInfo.summary: Shoot it while the larger value is lit.

steps.text: Complete A-B-C once for 2x bonus, a second time for 3x, and a third time for 5x.
Hit the yellow drop targets and the top lane to advance the lit Special route.
Use the white advance-bonus shots to build the bonus collected at the end of the ball.
Shoot the spinner while its larger displayed value is lit, then return to the nearest incomplete A-B-C or yellow-target set.

alternatives.title: Finish the bonus multiplier
alternatives.when: Use this when two A-B-C letters are already lit.

steps.text: Complete the missing letter for the next Bonus X step.
Resume the yellow-target Special route after the set resets.
Build the white-shot bonus after the multiplier is established.

machineSetup: Check Bonus X, Special thresholds, spinner values, bonus limits, and extra-ball or replay awards.
Test A-B-C, all yellow drops, top lane, white advance-bonus switches, spinner, bonus unit, and Special lamps.

cautions.issue: One secondary rapid-bonus interaction is uncertain.
cautions.response: Use the clearly labeled A-B-C, yellow-target, advance-bonus, and spinner routes instead of assuming an extra bonus effect.
